svg.title: Synthetic A/B checkpoint notes: proposed review exercise
svg.desc: Two synthetic notes differ: draft A becomes draft B. Version A is assumed reviewed only for this proposed exercise. The changed B note is labelled and underlined. Proposed checks are to retain B after reopening and require a fresh context review. Owner review is empty. This unpublished conceptual image depicts no actual test receipt, private checkpoint or live product screen.
